you.name: Crew
you.briefing: One of you is carrying something. You saw it in their face when the Anomaly woke, and now the brood moves when they move. There's still a chance: a counter-agent can be synthesized in the Med Bay, Hydroponics or the Containment Lab. Make a dose, get close enough, and inject the host. Stay together. The brood is strong, but it can only stun, and only the host can be stopped.
objectives: Synthesize a dose in a lab (Tech 5+), then inject the host.
